title: Supreme Court: Weyerhaeuser Co. v. United States Fish and Wildlife Serv.
summary: An area is eligible for designation as “critical habitat” under the Endangered Species Act of 1973 only if it is habitat for the listed species; and the Secretary of the Interior’s decision not to exclude an area from critical habitat under 16 U. S. C. §1533(b)(2) is subject to judicial review. (No. 17-71, opinion by Chief Justice Roberts; 586 U.S. 9).

title: Supreme Court: Mount Lemmon Fire Dist. v. Guido
summary: State and local governments are covered employers under the Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967 regardless of the number of employees they have. (No. 17-587, opinion by Justice Ginsburg; 586 U.S. 1).
